newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin significantly more active, Kremlin says.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin significantly more active, Kremlin says.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, who is recovering from pneumonia in hospital, has become more active and has begun working on documents, the Kremlin said in a statement on Sunday.
The latest report by doctors on Sunday said he was in a stable condition with normal blood pressure, pulse and temperature. His treatment is continuing.
"To a significant degree, his activity has increased, and B.N. Yeltsin has begun to work on documents," the bulletin released early on Sunday afternoon.
Yeltsin checked into hospital on Wednesday with pneumonia in both lungs, just two months after undergoing quintuple heart bypass surgery.
His continued absence from the Kremlin has raised fears that he will be unable to devote enough energy to Russia's problems in the future.
According to doctors, Yeltsin is receiving antibiotics to combat his pneumonia.
